# artifact media type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:artifactMediaType`](gmeow-artifactMediaType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/artifactMediaType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)

The media type of the attestation artifact's serialization (e.g. application/vnd.in-toto+json, application/vc+ld+json).

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:AttestationArtifact`](../classes/gmeow-AttestationArtifact.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal); functional
